WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON CAST(s.transref AS TEXT) = CAST(tx.transreg AS TEXT)
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON CAST(tx.trdref AS TEXT) = CAST(tr.tradereg AS TEXT)
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT
    step1.transref,
    step1.tradekind,
    step1.avg_anlycount,
    step1.avg_anlycount - step2.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM step1
  JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  WHERE step1.avg_anlycount > step2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(difference) AS avg_difference
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM step4
)
SELECT
  step4.tradekind,
  step4.avg_anlycount,
  step4.avg_difference,
  step4.avg_anlycount / step5.overall_avg
FROM step4
JOIN step5 ON step5.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
